rationale: CR-001 is resolved. The fix-up commit (1611366f5) adds an explicit `isinstance(dict)` check before `_raw_extra.items()`, setting `_raw_extra = None` and emitting a `logger.error` when the value is a truthy non-dict. This directly addresses the CR-001 failure scenario (truthy non-dict raising AttributeError silently absorbed as 401). A new test `test_extra_attributes_non_dict_type_drops_to_none` provides direct coverage for the list-input case. The fix-up diff is minimal (5 production lines, 21 test lines) with no new high-risk issues: no new API surface, no new async concerns, no injection risk in the f-string. All prior findings are resolved.

standards_review.notes: Fix-up commit follows EPMCDME-####: description format. Commit message names the exact root cause and fix approach.
isinstance guard and logger.error conform to project logging patterns. f-string uses type().__name__, not user input.
No new security surface. logger.error for the non-dict case surfaces the failure rather than silently absorbing it as 401.

finding_status.notes: isinstance(dict) guard added before _raw_extra.items(). Non-dict triggers logger.error and _raw_extra = None. test_extra_attributes_non_dict_type_drops_to_none covers list-input case.
